email_subject: Application - Junior Technical Support Specialist at YIELDS NV
email_body:
Dear YIELDS team,

I am applying for the Junior Technical Support Specialist role in Berchem. Your focus on model/AI risk management and complex enterprise SaaS support matches my technical and customer-facing background.

At Knowledge Experts (KXP), I supported SharePoint-based digital workplace builds for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff), which taught me to translate business needs into technical requirements and to investigate issues to root cause. As a freelancer, I build and maintain WordPress sites, write Python automation, and use SQL and databases in my daily work. I am fluent in English and comfortable guiding non-technical users through technical problems.

I am eager to learn MRM and AI governance and to grow into an implementation consultant or account management role. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear YIELDS team,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Technical Support Specialist position at YIELDS NV in Berchem. Your work supporting domain experts in model/AI risk management, model development and validation through complex product queries, custom configurations and bug resolution is exactly the kind of technical puzzle-solving I enjoy. I am drawn to the clear growth path towards implementation consulting or customer success account management, and I am eager to build deep expertise in MRM and AI governance.

My background combines technical support, web development and analytical problem-solving. At Knowledge Experts (KXP), I supported the team building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff). That experience taught me to translate business needs into clear technical requirements, to reproduce and verify issues, and to communicate with stakeholders until a solution was in place. As a freelancer, I design, build and maintain WordPress sites, write Python automation, and work with databases and SQL daily. I also use LLMs and prompt engineering in my workflow, which helps me understand AI-powered products from the inside.

I am fluent in English and comfortable guiding users through technical challenges with patience and ownership. I enjoy investigating root causes rather than passing issues along, and I take responsibility for client communication from first report to final resolution. I am based in Zwijndrecht, close to Berchem, and happy to work at least two days per week in the office.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical and customer-focused skills can support your clients. Thank you for your consideration.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
